list.name: product
list.query: SELECT name FROM gold.dim_product WHERE dbt_valid_to IS NULL ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.snapshot_date AS time, f.current_stock FROM gold.fact_inventory_snapshot f JOIN gold.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE p.name = '$product' AND p.dbt_valid_to IS NULL AND f.snapshot_date > current_date - 30 ORDER BY 1

WITH restocks AS (SELECT product_id, changed_at, changed_at - LAG(changed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY changed_at) AS gap FROM silver.inventory_history WHERE change_reason = 'restock') SELECT p.name, avg(extract(epoch FROM gap))/86400.0 AS avg_days_between_restocks, count(*) AS restock_events FROM restocks r JOIN gold.dim_product p ON p.product_id = r.product_id AND p.dbt_valid_to IS NULL WHERE gap IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY avg_days_between_restocks

SELECT p.name, sum(fs.qty_on_order) AS units_sold_30d, i.current_stock FROM gold.fact_sales fs JOIN gold.dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key JOIN gold.fact_inventory_snapshot i ON i.product_id = p.product_id AND i.snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM gold.fact_inventory_snapshot) WHERE fs.updated_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY p.name, i.current_stock ORDER BY units_sold_30d DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM silver.inventory_history WHERE current_stock = 0
SELECT product_id, changed_at, current_stock FROM silver.inventory_history WHERE current_stock = 0 ORDER BY changed_at DESC LIMIT 20
